title: Base Labs, Hugging Face and Goodfire form an open-model safety partnership
friendlyTitle: Three AI groups will build safety tools for open models
summary: Baseten’s Base Labs is partnering with Hugging Face and Goodfire to develop and publish training, evaluation and monitoring methods for open-weight models. The effort is intended to make safety techniques and operational infrastructure available beyond closed frontier laboratories.
friendlySummary: Base Labs, Hugging Face and Goodfire plan to publish ways to test and monitor open AI models. The work is meant to be useful outside the biggest AI companies.
whyItMatters: Open models are increasingly deployed inside products and private infrastructure, where the original developer cannot monitor every use. Shared evaluation and monitoring tools could give smaller teams a more practical safety baseline before deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Smaller teams also need ways to check whether a model is safe enough for their product. Shared tools can make those checks easier to run.
